name: X1's Executor-class Star Dreadnought
description: This Executor-class Star Dreadnought was a warship in the service of the Galactic Empire. Following the death of Emperor Palpatine at the Battle of Endor, this Star Dreadnought became the flagship of X1, a Force-sensitive clone and aspiring emperor. Following the New Republic's liberation of Cloud City on Bespin, X1 used the Super Star Destroyer to travel to Bast Castle, the former retreat of the Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Vader, on the acid rain-drenched planet Vjun to learn the secrets of the dark side of the Force.

data.name: X1's Executor-class Star Dreadnought
